integrity: Claimed global classification follows from exact symmetric-polynomial identities, strict rational parameter monotonicity, and asymptotic expansions. Included symbolic and high-precision checker is supporting evidence, not an independent proof or historical priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only the nonnegative-coefficient cubic (c,m>=0, c+m>0), only primitive period-two pairs with both coordinates in (0,1), no stability/higher-period/global attraction classification. The r to infinity continuation need not leave the entire interval invariant. Strong-Allee c<0 not included. Historical priority provisional; 2020 special-case article available as abstract only.
title: Global uniqueness and two boundary scales of prime-two orbits in a generalized Allee-logistic map
